student: student-4x768: 4 layers, hidden 768, 12 heads, FFN 3072, BamiBERT vocab, max_length 32, positions 2050 (copied whole)

init.pretrained: Qualcomm-AI-Research/BamiBERT pretrained encoder (the checkpoint the teacher was fine-tuned from), embeddings + embedding LayerNorm + layers [2,5,8,11] (0-based; top layer of each 3-layer block), shape-identical copies only
init.heads: fresh seeded nn.Linear init, bit-identical across all arms of a seed (model built as random first, then encoder overwritten)

recipe_all_arms.schedule: linear warmup/decay, last epoch kept, no selection
recipe_all_arms.lr_rationale: student-v1 lr 5e-4 is 10x the conventional BERT fine-tuning rate and would overwrite copied weights; 5e-5 is the teacher's own fine-tuning lr. Epoch budget = student-v1 (40 epochs, 3,640 steps).

fit_check: If arm C does not fit its training data under the shared recipe (final-epoch in-sample validation type macro-F1 or span F1 < 0.95), run a labelled supplementary random-supervised 4x768 arm with the student-v1 recipe (lr 5e-4) so capacity is not judged on an under-trained control. Decided on training/in-sample signals only, never test or probe.
